title: Whisper e nder henndu
intro: Miijo-ɗee laamu ɗo ko yi’aaka e ko yi’aaka njiidi, aɗa darii e yeeso mbaydi e nder ɓernde laamu ngu nanndaani e goɗɗo. Ooɗoo ruuhu ina jogii ganndal ɓurngal heewde doole, ina yamira doole ɗe woɗɓe mbaawi miijaade tan. Kono hay ɓurɗo doole ina waawi lesɗineede e tagoore tokosere, goonga ina waawi suuɗde haa waktu toɗɗaaɗo oo. Hol ooɗoo limoore nde lefol mum ina ɓuuɓtoo e nder yontaaji ?
clues: Mi hokkaama laamu ngu hay gooto caggal am heɓataa.
Mi ronii ganndal e hakkille e jibinannde am giɗaande.
Henndu nduu ina woni e les yamiroore am, ina yaha e yamiroore am ɗo njiɗmi fof.
Miɗo waawi faamde haala colli ɗii, ɗi ngollii e konu am.
Mi heɓi kabaaru e colli tokoosi ko fayti e laamɗo debbo rewoowo naange.
Maayde am heddii ina suucfi haa tagoore leydi 6uuccii sawru am, ko ndeen jinneeji ɗii nganndi 6e nganndaa ko yi’aaka.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Maayde makko suuɗaa e jinneeji haa sawru makko ñaamee
O ummiima dow asamaan o wuuri
O danndaa e yiite ko e yamiroore Alla
O hisnaa ko e baleejo oo
outcome.answer: Maayde makko suuɗaa e jinneeji haa sawru makko ñaamee

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
